In today's digital age, convenience often comes at the cost of privacy. Every time a user browses a website, clicks a link, or uses an app, their data is collected sometimes without their knowledge. solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights that while technology brings convenience, it risks privacy due to unchecked data collection and weak implementation of laws.
 
• The author emphasizes the need for individuals to balance benefits of technology with their **right to privacy**.
 
• To achieve this, the passage stresses on **awareness, regulation, and responsible digital behavior**.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate answer is **Option 3: Awareness and responsible behavior**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Avoiding all apps** – Unrealistic and not suggested by the author.
 
• **Option 2: Stronger surveillance tools** – This would increase monitoring, not protect privacy.
 
• **Option 4: Free mobile phones for all** – Irrelevant to the issue of privacy.
